title: Aisa pamal koi ran me na dulha dekha
body:
AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN ME NA DULHA DEKHA
<<DIVIDER>>
CHAND LAMHOUN KI DULHAN HO GAYE PALME BEWA
DASTE GHURBATH MAIN AJAB TARHA KI DEKHI SHADI
HAYE SEY ROOZ KE PAYASE THE BARATHI MAIN SABHI
NAIK LENE KO CHALI DAR PA SAKINA DUKHIYA
<<MINI>>
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA--
<<DIVIDER>>
ROKE DETI THI SADA ZAINAB-E-MUZTAR JAAO
BHABI FARWA KO KOYI LAASHE PISAR PAR LAAO
KEHDO MILNE KE LIYE MADAR SE BETA AAYA
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA— APNI RUDAD BAYAN KIS SE KAREGI KUBRA
<<DIVIDER>>
RUN SE KUCH DEER ME DULHE KA JO LASHA AAYA
THI YAHI QAIMOUN ME US DAM HAYE QASIM KI SADA
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA— SHADI HOKAR BHI ABHI GUZRE NA THE KUCH LAMHE
SAR PA DULHAN KE AJAB DARD KE SAYE CHAYE
<<DIVIDER>>
HAYE POSHAK ME SHADI KI DULHAN THI BEWA
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA— QAIMAYE SHAH HAR SIMTH THA KOHRAM BAPA AUR KUBRA KE LABOUN PAR THA FAQATH WAWAILA
DEEKH KAR LAASHAYE QASIM KO YE MADAR NE KAHA
<<MINI>>
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA--
<<DIVIDER>>
GHIR GAYA HAYE JAFAKAROUN ME JO IBNE HASAN
RAITH PAR HOGAYA TAQSEEM LO DULHA KA BADAN
HAYE PEHCHAN NA PAYE THE SHAHE DEEN LASHA
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA— QOON ME DOOBH GAYA SEHRA BANE KA RUN MAIN
MUNTASHIR HO GAYA TAN KARBOBALA KE BAN MAIN
LAASH PAR KARTE THE SHABBIR SOHAIL AAHO BUKA
<<MINI>>
--AYSA PAMAL KOI RUN MAIN NA DULHA DEKHA--
